date.as_written: svasti śrīnepālīsamvat 686 bhādrava śudinanavamyāyāṃ tithau || somavārasare gurūpustakako miti ... svasti śrīnepālisamvat 1018 mitipauṣaśudi cautitithau || somavārasare

notes: The catalogue records NS 686 as the date of copying. However, the colophon states that NS 686 Bhādrapada śukla 9 Somavāsara was the date of the exemplar (gurūpustakako miti), whereas the present copy was completed on NS 1018 Pauṣa śukla 4 Somavāsara. No individual names are mentioned.
